column2: This dataset rates all projects in the capital budget with their climate alignment and categorizes investments that are related to climate. Amounts are in thousands. This dataset will be updated once a year during the Executive Budget.

column2: To meet requirement in Section 258.1 In the City Charter. This data is collected to support New York City's Climate Budgeting initiative and to assess NYC's progress towards its climate goals. This data shows how much of the city's current capital budget is aligned with the city's climate goals.

column2: OMB's Environmental Sustainability and Resiliency (ESR) Taskforce used information from the city's financial management system and did a manual analysis to determine the alignment of capital projects and relevant climate tracking category.
